name: owner-workbench
description: Owner personal workbench: React foundation alongside the preserved HUD prototype.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs server.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig*.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs package.json
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
